briefdescription.para: Update step of the Kalman FIlter. This is the method that is called after gathering data in the ROS2 node and constitutes the main part of the EKF. Measurements are compared to predictions, and based on the computed Kalman Gain, a refined state estimate is provided. Offers also the possibility to adapt the covariance matrices and estimate Pacejka parameters.
